This is the 8th installment of WCA Rubik's Cube Competition in Baguio City!
This time, the competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

Registrations will be accepted based on the following:
● 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors.
● Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis.
● If greater than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
● If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

# **REGISTRATION**
The registration fee is good for **ALL EVENTS/PUZZLES** of your choice.

Early registration is from February 15 to March 25 at Php 250.00 for Kiddie Division (4-11 years old) and Php 350.00 for Open Division.
Late registration is from March 26 to 29 (before 3x3x3 R1 starts) at Php 350.00 (Kiddie Division) and Php 450.00 for Open Division. 

To register, use the WCA website and follow the payment details **if you are a returning competitor**. **If you are a newcomer**, please contact Xavier De Vera at 09461564040 for the details.

Payment Method:
Slots are secured via payment-first system. You may pay for your registration fees via:

**GCash Express Send**
Account Name: Xavier De Vera
Account Number: 0946 156 4040

** PLEASE indicate the NAME OF THE COMPETITOR in message/note tab in GCash app before sending payment. You can also send the proof of payment to xprestousa.27@gmail.com. Failing to do so might revoke your registration.

Welcome to TahimiKubing in MultiLupa 2024, the first speedcubing competition in Muntinlupa City! Rather than most standard competitions, this competition features **all Blindfolded events (3x3 Blindfolded, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind), Fewest Moves Challenge, and Clock**, with **3x3 Multi-blind** as the main event.

Considering the nature of these events, competitors and spectators are required to remain silent during ongoring rounds. **There also is no regular 3x3 in the competition**. If you are looking for a more typical competition experience, feel free to check out [other competitions happening in the Philippines.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Philippines&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list)

We also highly discourage competitors from only registering for Clock.

**IMPORTANT NOTES:**
• Given the venue's size limitations, **competitors are strictly required to bring a maximum of one guest**. Please consider coming without a guest as the venue's accommodation size is limited.

• **If you are planning to attempt 10 or more cubes in 3x3 Multi-Blind, please contact the organizers ahead of time so that we can accommodate your attempt logistically.**

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.
